vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module provides utility functions for managing server relay configurations, specifically for routing model inference to a remote Brain Server. It handles the normalization of URLs to ensure correct protocol and format. Key functions determine if a relay request targets the local machine, preventing infinite request loops during self-relay scenarios.
